behavior: The signer settles a paid invoice once, with the executor key, only when terms and chain check out
acceptance: On Anvil with the real contracts, a settlement intent re-reads the terms, recomputes the address, checks the balance on chain, deploys the receiver if needed and calls settle; the recipient gets exactly the amount
A second intent for the same invoice is rejected; killing the signer after sending and restarting it sends nothing again (reconciled by nonce and tx hash)
Terms whose recipient or address does not match are refused and nothing is sent
notes: 2026-10-09 From F045 review: settlement_intents.status 'failed' requires tx_hash, so R-22's 'refused, nothing sent' needs a status without tx_hash (e.g. 'refused') or a relaxed CHECK.

2026-10-09 review fail by subagent: Money paths hold: the signer signs only factory.deploy(terms) on the compiled factory and settle() on the locally recomputed receiver, the tx is EIP-155 signed for the invoice chain, and the contract pays exactly amount to the committed recipient once. DB tampering or a lying RPC cannot redirect money or settle twice. Tests pass: go test -count=3 -race ./internal/settlement (ok 22.6s); pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test (all ok). BLOCKING (PoCs run on Anvil in a scratch copy): (1) service.go:92-95,108-111 run the DB checks and the receiver check BEFORE reconcile for status=sent, so an intent whose signed settle is in flight can be marked refused (reason 'recipient is not the profile wallet' after a wallet change, or a glitchy status answer). The tx then mines: recipient got 5000000 on chain, intent refused, settlement_status pending, ledger never books, refused is terminal. Breaks the stated invariant 'refused = nothing sent'. Fix: for sent intents reconcile first; the checks gate signing only. (2) service.go:114-123 and 174/205: transient chain conditions are terminal refusals. PoC: setPaused(true), Run, setPaused(false), Run -> intent refused, recipient 0, nothing resumes it; only a slog.Warn. Same for a lagging RPC's balance < amount, an RPC on the wrong chain, and a reverted settle (Paused, or AlreadySettled after a lagging-node nonce reset, which leaves the chain settled and the ledger not). Fix: retry those with next_attempt_at backoff (and on a reverted receipt re-read status: settled -> confirm); keep refusal for DB term mismatches and settler != executor. NON-BLOCKING: (3) service.go:170-172 confirms on any successful receipt for the stored tx_hash; PoC with a DB-tampered tx_hash -> confirmed and booked while the receiver still holds 6000000. Check the decoded raw_tx To == receiver, data == settle(), or the Settled log. (4) confirm books at latest, not finalized (D-45); a reorged-out settle that is not re-included leaves the ledger saying settled. (5) service.go:151 ignores rows affected of the save UPDATE. (6) service.go:178 uses s.sender, not the saved sender column (key rotation). (7) no fee bump: a stuck deploy makes a new deploy tx every run (125-139); await blocks 60 s per intent sequentially; next_attempt_at never set. (8) service.go:304 panics if a chain has no baseFee. (9) signer does not re-read ledger recipient_payable as architecture.md says (accepted risk in money-safety). (10) tests: 'kill after send' passes via status.settled because Anvil automines, not via the receipt path; nonce-taken path, factory mismatch and chain refusals untested (PoC shows nonce-taken works). (11) 00004 Down fails if refused rows exist. Ledger booking (receiver -amount, recipient_payable +amount, one per invoice, balanced), no secrets logged, stopAfter is unexported/test-only, must-not-change paths untouched.

2026-10-09 review pass by subagent: Re-review of HEAD 0d61694 (task = git diff HEAD~2). Both blocking findings fixed and verified. (1) service.go:99-102: a sent intent goes straight to reconcile; scratch PoC (wallet changed while the saved settle is unsent) now ends confirmed/settled, recipient 5000000. (2) service.go:120-125,188-218,249-256: wrong chain, balance below amount, not settleable, a mined settle that left the receiver unsettled, and a taken nonce now retry with 1 min doubling to 1 h; PoCs: pause -> pending with reason, unpause -> confirmed; saved settle mined reverted while paused -> pending, then a new settle confirms; nonce taken -> pending, then confirms. Refusal stays only for term mismatch, another predicted address, settler != executor. Non-blocking fixes verified: (3) service.go:177-180 saved bytes must be settle() on this receiver, this chain, saved hash, and confirm needs receiver.settled() (PoC: foreign tx_hash -> error, nothing booked, receiver keeps 6000000); (5) rows-affected check at 159; (6) nonce read for the saved sender at 194; (8) nil BaseFee is an error at 327; (11) Down resets refused rows. No money path changed: still only deploy on the compiled factory and settle on the recomputed receiver; the contract pays exactly amount to the committed recipient once. Runs: go test -count=3 -race ./internal/settlement ok 44.8s; pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test all ok. Still open, documented in architecture.md, not blocking: booking at latest not finalized (D-45); no fee bumping (a stuck deploy adds a new deploy per run; await blocks 60 s per intent); signer does not read ledger recipient_payable (accepted risk in money-safety.md). Minor: service.go:97 formats a nil error with %w when the chain ID differs; plain errors (RPC down, bad saved bytes) retry every run without next_attempt_at backoff; retry drops the old tx hash for the nonce-taken case (only the reason remains).

proof.1: backend: TestSettlesAPaidInvoiceOnce on Anvil with the real factory deployed by Deploy.s.sol at the compiled address: a 5 USDC invoice paid 6 goes paid -> intent; the signer re-reads terms, recomputes the address, reads factory.status, deploys the receiver and settles; the recipient gets exactly 5000000, the 1000000 excess stays, ledger receiver 1000000 / owed 0 / held 1000000, invoice settled
proof.2: backend: TestSettlesAPaidInvoiceOnce (second intent is a unique violation; a second run sends nothing), TestRestartAfterSavingSendsTheSavedTransaction, TestRestartAfterSendingSendsNothing, TestNonceTakenByAnotherTransaction (reconciled by nonce: signs again, settles once), TestSentSettleIsFinishedEvenIfTheWalletChanged, TestForeignTxHashIsNotConfirmed, TestPausedFactoryIsRetried
proof.3: backend: TestRefusesTermsThatDoNotMatch: a profile wallet that is no longer the recipient, and terms changed so they no longer compute the stored receive address, are refused with that reason; executor nonce, recipient and receive balances unchanged
